title: IRBCAM Target List v0
description: Normative JSON Schema for IRBCAM target list JSON format. See docs/28-apt-irbcam-dialects.md and IRBCAM vendor target specification.
$comment: Authored from IRBCAM documentation (JSON/CSV target list specification) and verified against Lean 4 model Dry.Language.Irbcam.

targets.description: Ordered sequence of 6-DOF robot target points and trajectory waypoints.

toolNumber.description: Sparse modal tool assignments as (targetIndex, value) pairs. Indices must be strictly increasing.

spindleSpeed.description: Sparse modal spindle speeds (RPM) as (targetIndex, value) pairs. Indices must be strictly increasing.

x.description: Tool center point X coordinate in millimetres.

y.description: Tool center point Y coordinate in millimetres.

z.description: Tool center point Z coordinate in millimetres.

rz1.description: First Z rotation of ZYZ Euler orientation in degrees (or radians if configured).

ry.description: Y rotation of ZYZ Euler orientation in degrees (or radians if configured).

rz2.description: Second Z rotation (spin) of ZYZ Euler orientation in degrees (or radians if configured).

velocity.description: Velocity in mm/s; literal -1 indicates rapid traverse rate, positive numbers represent feed velocity.

type.description: Target type: 0 for linear motion endpoint, 1 for circular arc midpoint.

targetIndex.description: 0-based index of the target where this tool applies from.
0-based index of the target where this spindle speed applies from.

value.description: Spindle speed in RPM (or proportional extrusion flow signal under SpindleRate policy).
